visualCharacteristics.purpose: Oversized stacked headline over a full-width background photo
observed: Background photo + h2 "What Starts Here Changes The World" (line breaks between words)

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: heading (use line breaks to stack words), optional paragraph, optional CTA link
notes: Headline set over a photo background: a photo background belongs to its block (hero), so the section is not colored.

usage: Homepage or landing-page statement headline over a photo.
reuseGuidance: Use when the headline is the main content; for text plus stats and a side video use hero-split-video.
